title: Hero
purpose: Primary page introduction with clear value proposition and actions.

regions.notes: Keep the H1 before actions in source order.
Decorative media uses empty alt; meaningful media requires useful alternative text.

responsive.mobile: copy precedes media; actions wrap without changing DOM order

accessibility: One page-level H1 unless the host document explicitly requires otherwise.
Primary and secondary actions use links/buttons according to actual behavior.
Visual reordering must not contradict reading or focus order.
